UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information and statistics.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's profile photo.

isPremium.description: Whether the user has a premium subscription.

points.description: Total points earned by the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

quizId.description: ID or title of the quiz.

total.description: Total number of questions in the quiz.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the quiz was completed.

/users/{userId}/history/{historyId}.description: Sub-collection of quiz history for a specific user.
